'''Operation Sunder Zero''' was a two-part military operation carried out by the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The [[Coruscant Aegis]] squadron and the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Battle of the Hydian Way|broke]] a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] blockade of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]], and destroyed the [[Rancor's Claw]] squadron in [[Battle of the Drexel system|battle]] in the [[Drexel system/Legends|Drexel system]].
